structured_sections.name: Intro
lines: Title: Khumaar
Duration: ~4:12
Genre: Bollywood Acoustic Indie Ballad / Late-Night Unplugged Pop

structured_sections.name: Intro
lines: (Gentle fingerpicked acoustic guitar, subtle ambient room reverb, soft rhythmic palm mute, warm low hum)
(Mmm... haan... hmm...)

structured_sections.name: Mukhda / Chorus
lines: Aadhi si raat hai, khamosh yeh shehar hai,
Tu saamne hai baithi, bas tera hi asar hai.
Nazrein chura ke tu jo halke se hasi hai,
Seene mein mere ik ajeeb si khalish hai.
Yeh kaisa khumaar hai, kaisa yeh suroor hai,
Paas hoke bhi tu kyun lagti thodi door hai?
Tu hans ke bahaana koi bana degi kya?
Main sach bol doon agar, toh muskura degi kya?
Jo lafz dabe hain kabse seene mein mere,
Unhein aaj tu sun kar, gale se laga degi kya?

structured_sections.name: Antara 1 / Verse 1
lines: Kanch ke gilaas mein baraf pighalti hai,
Tujhse nazar milti hai, saans sambhalti hai.
Duniya ki baaton ka ab darr nahi koi,
Tere siwa dil ka ab ghar nahi koi.
Zulfon ko kaan ke peeche jo tu karti hai,
Sach kehna, tu bhi kya mujhpe hi marti hai?
Thoda sa jhooth hi sahi, tu keh ke dikha,
Is bhatke musafir ko raasta tu dikha!

structured_sections.name: Mukhda Reprise / Chorus
lines: Yeh kaisa khumaar hai, kaisa yeh suroor hai,
Paas hoke bhi tu kyun lagti thodi door hai?
Tu hans ke bahaana koi bana degi kya?
Main sach bol doon agar, toh muskura degi kya?

structured_sections.name: Antara 2 / Verse 2
lines: Do baje ki chai ho ya chaar baje ki baat,
Kash koi thehra de yeh haseen raat.
Log kehte hain ke main thoda sa deewaana hoon,
Tere shehar mein bhatka ek be-ghar puraana hoon.
Meri khamoshi mein jo shor chupa hai,
Tere hi naam ka ik mod chupa hai.
Agar haath badha ke main rokk loon tujhe,
Bata na, yeh dil be-qasoor hai na?

structured_sections.name: Bridge
lines: Aankhon mein dekha hai maine ek pal ke liye,
Tu bhi toh ruki hai bas ek hal ke liye.
Kal subah jab roshni khidki se aayegi,
Tu kya yeh saari baatein bhool jaayegi?
Bol na...
Kya sach mein bhool jaayegi?

structured_sections.name: Chorus / Climax
lines: Yeh kaisa khumaar hai, kaisa yeh suroor hai!
Paas hoke bhi tu kyun lagti thodi door hai!
Tu hans ke bahaana koi bana degi kya?
Main sach bol doon agar, toh muskura degi kya?
Jo lafz dabe hain kabse seene mein mere,
Unhein aaj tu sun kar, gale se laga degi kya?

structured_sections.name: Outro
lines: Haan gale se laga degi kya...
Yeh kaisa khumaar hai...
Bas tu hi tu hai...
Aur tera khumaar hai...
(Soft acoustic guitar strum fading, warm resonant open chord, gentle breath out)
